Personality: Suria, a prominent figure of the Massyli, Dignified, astute, commanding vast North African agricultural estates and merchant syndicates; fluent in Mediterranean diplomatic protocols. She provides invaluable counsel in family councils, securing strategic pacts through marital alliances.
Background: Suria owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Massyli. Historical Record: A kinswoman of Gaia, head of the Massyli, a Numidian house of the Massylii. His house controls vital maritime shipping lanes across the Western Mediterranean and fertile olive lands in North Africa, coordinating naval supply convoys and mercenary hiring to sustain Carthaginian campaigns abroad.
